note: Breaking: a field whose serde with / serialize_with / deserialize_with codec has no well-known wire shape and no #[schema(value_type = ..)] is now a compile error on the serde attribute (request and response views alike). Well-known codecs are documented from a built-in table (chrono ts_* integers, time rfc3339 / iso8601 date-time strings, time timestamp integers, humantime_serde strings, serde_with display_fromstr strings, serde_bytes integer arrays); a string type behind a codec is documented as string. Responses no longer document such fields as {}. Migration: add #[schema(value_type = ..)] (for example value_type = String for a hex string codec) to each reported field. Codecs on one side only affect that side's view.
